title: Mobile: Empty states for all screens

title: Mobile: Stack initialRouteName sticks on settings after setup
description: After finishing setup the root stack stays on the settings route even though the tabs screen is now available. Because the stack isn't remounted, navigation.canGoBack() remains false and the auto-dismiss logic in settings never fires, so the user is stuck on the modal.
notes: 2025-10-29: Selecting the first tracked account still triggers the auto-dismiss flow. Plan: gate the onboarding dismissal so it only fires when the modal can't be popped (initial setup) and after an explicit 'Finish setup' CTA, leaving the sheet open while users pick multiple accounts.

title: Mobile: settings disconnect should clear budgets
description: Disconnecting from the Settings screen leaves previously fetched budgets in the list. After clearing the PAT we expect the budgets/accounts collections to reset so the UI reflects a fully disconnected state.
notes: Testing disconnect shows AsyncStorage state isn’t reset even after relaunch; budgets still present.

title: Mobile: PAT connect spinner never resolves without budget selection
description: After entering a PAT and tapping Connect the status badge stays on 'Connecting…' until the user also chooses a budget. The connection feels stuck even though authentication succeeded. Ideally the UI should acknowledge a successful PAT immediately and prompt for budget selection separately.
notes: 2025-10-29: After selecting a budget the banner still shows 'Awaiting budget selection' and the only activity indicator lives at the top of the modal. Plan: keep the optimistic status copy in sync with connectionStatus transitions, surface an inline progress row near the budget/confirm controls, and finish by clearing the spinner once the post-budget sync completes so reopening settings doesn't flash 'Connecting…'.

title: Mobile: Settings account selection shouldn't force resync spinner
description: When reopening the settings sheet the status row flashes a spinner even though no sync is running, and toggling a second tracked account kicks off another sync that provides no new data. This makes the sheet feel jittery and dismisses focus from the list. Plan: stop auto-syncing on local tracked-account toggles, queue any needed recompute in the background, and only show the global spinner when a real fetch is in flight.
notes: Fixed: Implemented staged changes model that prevents auto-sync on account toggles. Account selection now stages changes locally and only syncs when explicitly applying via 'Finish setup' or 'Apply changes' buttons. Spinner only shows during actual sync operations. Fixed in PR #45.

title: Mobile: Replace custom tab bar with native iOS tabs
description: The bottom tab bar currently uses the Expo Router default, which doesn’t match native iOS controls. Investigate migrating to a native-feeling solution (e.g. react-navigation bottom tabs or Expo Router’s native-stack + bottom tabs) so we get proper haptics, safe-area handling, and accessibility. Deliverables: short comparison of available options, recommendation, and implementation plan.

title: Mobile: Home screen shows 'no cards configured' when cards exist but have no activity
description: The Home tab incorrectly displays the empty state ('No cards configured yet') when cards are configured but have no spending activity yet. The issue is in useCardSummaries() where isEmpty is set to true when summaries.length > 0 && !hasActivity. isEmpty should only be true when there are no cards at all (summaries.length === 0), not when cards exist but have zero activity.

title: Refresh button doesn't sync transactions from YNAB
description: The refresh button on HomeScreen only calls actions.refresh() which reloads storage but doesn't fetch new transactions from YNAB. Users need a way to manually trigger syncBudgetsAndAccounts to fetch fresh transaction data. The refresh button should trigger a sync, not just reload storage.

title: Fix stale closure in HomeScreen refresh callbacks
description:
The useFocusEffect and refresh button callbacks in apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx reference state.cards but only depend on state.cards.length. This causes stale card data to be used when calculating transaction fetch dates.

Fix: Change dependency array on line 345 from:
  [... state.cards.length ...]
to:
  [... state.cards ...]

Also affects the manual refresh button's onPress handler.

Impact: Low priority since mobile has no card editing UI yet. Will cause bugs when card billing cycle editing is implemented.

- apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:340,345,384
